title: Labyrinth Thread Maze
tagline: Follow the red thread through stone and torchlight.
description: A calm maze puzzle inspired by the stone labyrinths of ancient Crete. Guide a clay lamp through generated mazes to the glowing heart while a red thread lays out behind you and winds back when you retrace. Six grades, torchlight fog, a hint thread, a daily maze and Watch and Learn. Portrait or landscape, phone or tablet.
howToPlay: Press and drag: the lamp follows your finger through the corridors.
Walk back along your thread to undo a wrong turn; Last fork returns to your last choice.
Tap the bulb for a hint: first about the next fork, then a gold thread shows the way.
In the dark grades the lamp lights nearby corridors; tap Map to see where you have been.
Watch and Learn walks a maze for you and explains each fork.
